title: BreakCandidate
description: A potential ad-break point at a scene boundary, including cut-safety scoring and pacing eligibility.

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier for this break candidate, e.g. 'brk_0007'

timestamp.description: Position in the video (seconds) where this break would be inserted

scene_before.description: scene_id of the scene immediately before this break point

scene_after.description: scene_id of the scene immediately after this break point

cut_safety_score.description: Composite cut-safety score in [0, 1]; higher = safer place to cut

cut_safety_reasons.description: Decomposed sub-signals that contributed to cut_safety_score — never emit an opaque number without this

sentence_boundary_aligned.description: True if the cut falls on a sentence boundary per Whisper word-level timestamps

silence_gap_ms.description: RMS-silence duration (milliseconds) around the cut timestamp; larger = safer

shot_boundary_aligned.description: True if the cut coincides with a PySceneDetect shot boundary

action_continuity_penalty.description: Penalty [0, 1] applied when cutting mid high-motion action or mid camera pan; 0 = no penalty

pacing_eligible.description: True if this candidate survived the cut-safety floor and is eligible for pacing evaluation; null/unset during Phase 2

pacing_reasons.description: Pacing-engine bookkeeping at the time this candidate was evaluated; null/unset during Phase 2

final_decision.description: Terminal outcome for this candidate; null/unset during Phase 2
